<insights>The question asks about Wes Johnson's involvement in two video games: "Fallout 4" and one where the cover shows a gun-wielding man. The images provided show covers of various video games, including "Fallout 4," "The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim," "World of Warcraft," "Star Trek: Legacy," "Star Trek: Conquest," "The Elder Scrolls IV: Shivering Isles," "The Elder Scrolls Legends," "World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth," and "Octopath Traveler." However, only "Fallout 4" matches the description of having a cover showing a gun-wielding man.</insights>

<answer>Wes Johnson was involved in "Fallout 4," which has a cover showing a gun-wielding man.</answer>
